description.p: Oscillate is a digital audio workstation for Linux. Arrange audio and MIDI clips on a timeline, play its built-in instruments, shape the sound with its effects and mix the result into a finished track.

ul.li: Arrangement with audio and MIDI clips, markers, tempo and time-signature maps
Piano roll with velocity and pedal lanes, and MIDI recording from the computer keyboard
Synthesisers, drum and sampled instruments, including the Nova wavetable synth
More than twenty effects, from EQ and compression to reverb, delay and tape texture
Mixer with buses, sends, sidechains, macros, racks and freeze
Tempo and key analysis, warping and pitch editing of audio
Export of the master and stems as WAV, FLAC or MP3

description.p: Oscillate plays through PipeWire, or through JACK by way of PipeWire's JACK support. It is pre-release software.
